headline: Pakistan will send Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik to New Delhi for the SCO Civilizational Dialogue on November 20 to 22, the foreign ministry said on Saturday, Arab News reports.

card.desc: Event in New Delhi from November 20 to 22

caption:
Pakistani minister to make a rare visit to India! 🇵🇰
According to Arab News, the foreign ministry said on Saturday that Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik will represent Pakistan at the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) Civilizational Dialogue in New Delhi from November 20 to 22. It is a rare high-level visit to India, as ties have stayed strained since the May 2025 military clash between the two countries. Neither country has announced plans for bilateral talks during the event.
